name: workbench-codex-plugin
description: Portable local task coordination, repository hooks, and Git delivery workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, verify, and land local development tasks.
interface.longDescription: Plans and verifies isolated development tasks, refreshes Git context, and supports local-only, direct-push, and pull-request delivery. Repositories register their own setup and verification commands. Requires Node.js and Git.
defaultPrompt: Start a scoped development task in this repository.
Review and land the current Workbench task.
